teamMetricAdapter.sourceSeasonRule: target season start year minus one

temporalRules.playerRating: Use only the same playerRef overall and skill ratings from the season before the target game season; current-season end-of-season ratings are excluded from that season.
temporalRules.playerBox: Only regular-season positive-minute box rows whose local game date is earlier than the target local date are aggregated; earlier positive-minute short appearances remain valid history inputs.
temporalRules.teamResults: Only matched training-eligible regular-season team games dated before the target local date are aggregated.
temporalRules.teamStrength: Online opponent-adjusted team strength is updated only after every game on a local date; prior-season strength carries forward with 0.75 shrinkage at season transition.
temporalRules.teamHistory: Short, medium, and season-to-date team form use only earlier game dates; current-season summaries are shrunk toward a prior-season estimate and the prior league scoring level.
temporalRules.lineupChemistry: Use only same-team regular-season exact-five rows from the prior season; shrink each lineup deviation toward its team-season mean by observed possession exposure.
temporalRules.nbaComTeamStats: Use the explicit display-name-to-team-code adapter and completed regular-season source season target season minus one only; do not join same-season end-of-season team aggregates to games.
temporalRules.nbaComStatsLimit: Raw NBA.com Stats rows remain descriptive and ineligible in the package; this candidate applies a model-specific prior-season adapter and is a development experiment, not a point-in-time availability claim.

selectedCandidateLabel: History, ratings, six player box-rate models, and shot-process scoring rates with an optional bounded one-sided player performance-fatigue adjustment
selectedTotalCandidateLabel: Team/player scoring model plus prior-season matchup efficiency

totalTrainingWindow.note: Selected from a chronological development comparison; refit on the latest three eligible completed seasons.

interpretation: Model coefficients estimate predictive associations. They do not establish that the derived DJHC ratings are causal or independently validated player ability measurements.
Selected margin candidate Player ratings and dynamic opponent adjustment without extra form windows: chronological OOF MAE 10.829; development-only, not independent validation.

Selected total candidate Team/player scoring model plus prior-season matchup efficiency with rolling-3 fitting: chronological OOF MAE 16.026 overall and 15.842 for recent target seasons; comparison and limits are in the pinned evaluator report.

The six player box-rate models are experimental conditional rate components. Their per-stat development results are in the pinned rate report; they do not establish availability, minutes, coherent joint box distributions, or independent game-level predictive validity.

The shot-process scoring-rate model domainsShootingProcess has player points-per-36 OOF MAE 6.123 across domainsShootingProcess; it remains an experimental player-output model, not independent validation.
The live PBP engine updates player and team boxes from the same event deltas. Its generated event order and per-event player attribution remain uncalibrated against event-grain NBA play-by-play.
Home win probability is computed from the paired residual score distribution when available, with a normal-margin fallback only when the pair pool is absent.

inputRequirements.missingRequiredFieldsPolicy: Use the explicitly pinned V1 scoring-rate fallback model rather than treating unavailable shot history as zero.

playerGame.seasonYearSource: time.seasonStartYear is used to form the season windows and targets.

temporalEligibility.sameDateRows: All rows on a local date are excluded from every target on that date; append them to player history after feature construction for that date.

historyEligibility.negativeOrNonfiniteMinutes: Excluded before history or target construction.
historyEligibility.historyGrain: Positive-minute player-game rows, including rows with minutes from 0 exclusive to 6 exclusive.

seasonWindows.current: history rows where time.seasonStartYear equals target seasonStartYear
seasonWindows.prior: history rows where time.seasonStartYear equals target seasonStartYear minus 1
seasonWindows.otherSeasons: Excluded from current/prior rate windows and priorGames; recent fatigue windows use all earlier history.
seasonWindows.recentSource: Use current-season history when currentN is greater than zero; otherwise use prior-season history.
seasonWindows.recent10: Last 10 rows of recentSource, in ascending date/insertion order.
seasonWindows.recent5: Last 5 rows of recentSource, in ascending date/insertion order.
seasonWindows.currentN: Count of all positive-minute current-season player-game history rows before the target date, not only the recent 10.

shrinkage.currentN: All prior positive-minute history rows in the target season.
shrinkage.oneAvailableValueFallback: Use the available current or prior value without shrinkage.

per36.denominator: Sum of positive history minutes in the applicable window.

shootingAttempts.fallback: Use the available window rate; use 0 when neither window has positive minutes.

shootingEfficiency.aggregation: Aggregate makes, attempts, and points over each window before division; this is attempt-weighted, not an average of game percentages.
shootingEfficiency.nullAndFallback: A window with zero attempts yields null. Subtract each baseline before blending; use the available centered window value, or 0 when both are null.

fatigue.eligibleRows: All strictly earlier positive-minute history rows.
fatigue.dayDifference: Target local calendar day minus history local calendar day.
fatigue.fatigueLoad3: Sum minutes where dayDifference is in [1, 3].
fatigue.fatigueLoad7: Sum minutes where dayDifference is in [1, 7].
fatigue.fatigueWeightedLoad7: Sum minutes * exp(-dayDifference / 3) where dayDifference is in [1, 7].
fatigue.ratingInteractions: Each interaction is (fatigueLoad3 / 36) * the corresponding lagged centered rating.

priorGames.rawCount: current-season positive-minute history rows + prior-season positive-minute history rows.

ratings.lookup: Same playerRef in target seasonStartYear minus 1.
ratings.sourceTimeRelation: Exactly one season lag; current-season and same-season ratings are not used.
ratings.missingDomainFallback: Use neutral percentile 50 before centering that domain.

missingInputFallbacks.runtimeMissingRequiredShootingFeature: Use the explicitly pinned V1 scoring-rate fallback model.

historyPolicy.fatigueLoad3: Minutes in positive-minute appearances during the three complete local calendar days before the target game.
historyPolicy.fatigueWeightedLoad7: Prior seven-day minutes weighted by exp(-daysSinceGame / 3); built only from earlier local dates.
historyPolicy.workloadRatingInteractions: Candidate interactions between lagged DJHC rating domains and prior three-day workload; predictive associations only.
historyPolicy.shootingFeatures: Prior-date field-goal, free-throw, three-point, and two-point attempt rates plus attempt-weighted shooting efficiencies; current-season histories shrink toward the prior-season window.

fatiguePerformance.rationale: The fitted fatigueLoad7 term is retained as a workload/opportunity predictor. This separate one-sided adjustment is a development control for excess prior-seven-day load; it is not a causal or independently validated effect.

temporalRules.playerGameForm: Only eligible regular-season positive-minute player-game observations on local dates before the target date; all target-date games are added after feature construction. Short positive-minute appearances remain in history.
temporalRules.zeroMinuteHistory: Zero-minute rows are excluded from rate history and their nonzero box counts are recorded as source anomalies.
temporalRules.ratings: Only DJHC season-end ratings from the season before the target game season; missing prior ratings use neutral centered values.
temporalRules.target: Per-36 observed box rate for appearances with at least six minutes; actual minutes are used only as the exposure denominator and for a separately labeled oracle-minutes count metric.

playerRateInputContract.missingShootingFeaturePolicy: Use the explicitly pinned V1 scoring-rate fallback model rather than treating unavailable shot history as zero.

playerRateInputContract.ratings: Provide previous-season DJHC ratings on the 0-100 scale; missing ratings default to neutral values.
playerRateInputContract.temporalRequirement: All per36, trend, minutes, games, and fatigue inputs must be built from player games before the target local date. Do not pass target-game or same-date box data.
playerRateInputContract.minutesRequirement: Per36 rates are multiplied by simulator-normalized projected minutes; this model does not predict player availability or minutes.

boxScoreCoherence.points: Player points are allocated to sum to the simulated team score.
boxScoreCoherence.threePointersMade: The sampled 3PM count is capped at floor(player points / 3).
boxScoreCoherence.remainingRates: Rebounds, assists, turnovers, steals, and blocks are sampled separately and are not reconciled to team totals or cross-stat covariance.

livePlayByPlay.eventGrain: Generated possession and event sequence with score and full player/team box snapshot after every event.

requiredLinks.blocks: Each block references an opposing blocked field-goal attempt recorded as missed.
requiredLinks.steals: Each steal references an opposing turnover marked stolen.
requiredLinks.rebounds: Each rebound references a missed field goal or final missed free throw.
requiredLinks.madeShots: Made field goals update attempt, make, points, and optional assist totals together.

livePlayByPlay.boxScoreConsistency: Count stats reconcile exactly from player lines to team totals at each event; score matches points; player and team shot/rebound identities are checked.
livePlayByPlay.disclosure: Events are simulated from model outputs and player inputs. The V4 package contains final game boxes, not event-grain observed PBP; generated events are not historical NBA records.
livePlayByPlay.validation: Bounded five-seed engineering smoke check passed; this is not an event-level predictive validation.

seasonAgeAnchorIndex.description: Exact normalized player-name season-age anchors from the pinned V4 Career_State part.

provenance.seasonReferenceConvention: seasonStartYear 2024 means 2024-25; Basketball-Reference age is measured on January 31 of seasonStartYear + 1.
provenance.identityUse: Lookup is exact normalized name-key only. No approximate or fuzzy name matching is performed.
provenance.useLimit: Age-state context only; not an attribute progression or predictive rating model.

inferenceContract.scoreGeneration: fresh bivariate-normal residual draws from fitted moments
inferenceContract.fitSource: chronological out-of-fold residual moments; source rows removed from candidate output
inferenceContract.playerSeasonAge: exact normalized package name-key lookup; age measured January 31 of seasonStartYear + 1; advances from the latest source season at or before target season; birthDate fallback for unlisted synthetic players; same-season calls are idempotent

developmentNotes: The frozen 2026-10-06 checkpoint is the comparison baseline and is not modified by this candidate.
The workload coefficient remains in the fitted scoring-rate regression; the guard is applied only to standardized excess load above the fitted mean.
The adjustment uses a reciprocal one-sided response and is bounded at a 30% per-36 scoring-rate penalty; it must be re-estimated or rejected using chronological outcome evaluation before selection.
